persona: Mid-level retail recruiter with a few gaps
resumeText:
Rohan Mehta | Gurugram | rohan.mehta@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Talent Acquisition Executive, Kesar Retail Pvt Ltd, Gurugram (2023 - present)
- Ran end-to-end recruitment for 60 store and corporate roles a year, from requisition to joining.
- Sourced passive candidates with Boolean search on job portals and through employee referrals.
- Conducted telephonic screening of 40 candidates a week against the role brief.
- Scheduled interview rounds with store managers and regional heads.
- Tracked candidates and stages in Zoho Recruit and updated each requisition daily.
- Met hiring managers every Monday to agree role briefs and priorities.

Recruitment Executive, Aravalli Staffing Solutions, New Delhi (2021 - 2023)
- Organised campus drives at three Delhi colleges for management trainee hiring.
- Prepared weekly hiring trackers in Excel for client account managers.

EDUCATION
BBA, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, 2021

SKILLS
Sourcing, Zoho Recruit, MS Excel, time to fill
